name: Being Confident
overview: Scripture teaches that true confidence is rooted in our abiding relationship with Christ and the assurance of His ongoing work in our lives. Believers can be confident that God, who has called, justified, and glorified them, will faithfully complete the good work He began within them. This confidence is strengthened by knowing Christ deeply, relying on His power, and trusting in His ability to keep us from falling and present us blameless before His glory. Thus, Christian confidence is not self-reliant but firmly anchored in Christ's sustaining grace and resurrection power.
